RA-B.title: Rear Centre Arch RA-B
RA-B.note:
Made in 2 parts (the head meets the
existing rear column):
RA-B front arch, 237 deep, stops 3 mm
in front of the column cladding.
RA-B-BL back sides, 305 deep, beside
the column, follow the arch curve up
to the LF-C soffit (+2.292).
CNC MDF 18 formers, 8 FR MDF skins,
painted. 40 solid oak arch front.

labels.text: Front arch RA-B (237) + back sides RA-B-BL (305), 3 mm joint

LF-A.title: L Fascia LF-A
LF-A.note:

CL.title: Filler CL
CL.note:
Front filler between the front pier
and arch AW-A, same as the other
fillers: EGGER U775 ST9 White Grey 20,
face 100 behind the arch fronts,
50 return at the pier end.
Softwood battens 20 x 40 on the AW-A
end panel, bracketed to the pier.
Scribe to wall, floor and pier on site.

D-02.title: Cashier Counter D-02
D-02.note:
Made as 2 units: D-02 counter 700 x 1200
+ D-02-F display fridge 700 x 900, top +1.000.
D-02 as the back counter E-C1: SHS 40x40x2
frame on 4 adjustable feet, stainless 304
brushed 1.2 on MR MDF 16 (customer face, south
end, doors, drawer), MR 18 carcass, stainless
kick, travertine 20 top on MR 18 sub-top.
Wire management: 60 grommet, PVC duct 80x40 to
the floor box, cable tray under the top,
removable access panel. Power + data by MEP.
Fridge by others, fixed to D-02 on site.

CF-1.title: Ceiling Wood Frame CF-1
CF-1.note:
Wood frame round the flower grid, in the
C02 rattan tray. Underside +3.100.
Each member: a box of 18 FR MDF, oak
veneer to match EGGER H1145 ST10:
soffit, top and two sides (100 x 100).
All boards mitred 45 at the 4 corners.
Glue blocks inside @ 600, pin and glue.
Downlights GL-1 to GL-8 in the soffit,
50 in from the edge: cut on site.
Hangers to the slab: to confirm.
